company.name: Unlayer
company.shortDescription: Unlayer helps SaaS teams embed drag-and-drop builders for emails, pages, documents and popups with powerful APIs and a white-labeled UI.
company.description: Unlayer offers a 4-in-1 embeddable drag-and-drop content builder designed to help businesses create visually appealing emails, landing pages, documents, and popups without the need for coding. This innovative solution is backed by Y Combinator and has gained the trust of Fortune 500 companies such as Fidelity and Bank of America, as well as leading SaaS platforms like Keap and Hive. Unlayer empowers developers to directly integrate powerful, white-label design tools into their applications, transforming how teams design and collaborate on content.
